## Updated

- **The sidebar's Offerings list now follows the company selector.** Previously
  every offering you had access to was listed in the left navigation at once, no
  matter which company was chosen in the header switcher — with several companies
  configured that turned into a long, mixed list. The submenu now shows only the
  offerings belonging to the selected company, and swaps over as soon as you
  change the selection (no page reload needed).
- Under **All companies**, every offering you can see is still listed, but each
  entry is now labelled with its company name — so two companies that each have
  an offering with the same name are no longer indistinguishable in the nav.

## Fixed

- The current offering is now highlighted in the sidebar while you are viewing
  it. The highlight never appeared before, because the comparison included the
  `?companyId=` part of the link.
